Reuse of approved activity rows: boatman mooring inspection for the ferryman, household-servant work-area inspection for householder and mistress.
Sex is data (payload.actor_applicability.sex_category, one value each); enforcement is materializer/rt-people code.
Version 3 of m2c_npc_fisher_v1 and m2c_npc_household_servant_v1 only adds the canonical regional context reference.
limits: Occupations are editorial analogies: householder = haymaker (floodplain meadows and cattle; no source for Lower Dvina arable around 1230), mistress = cook_baker (household cooking and bread); confidence C/low. Narration must not present the mistress as a professional cook.
The mistress has no headdress: m2c clothing has no married-woman variant, while a married woman went covered around 1230. Follow-up: a headdress variant from game-base garments.
No winter hat or mittens for anyone (inherited from clothing v1).
Sex is enforced by the rt-people materializer code (payload.actor_applicability.sex_category); merge together with rt-people, otherwise a mistress can be male.
Future subjects with occupation haymaker or cook_baker and no profile_ref resolve to the householder or mistress profile; they need an explicit profile_ref.
D-2 is not seasonal: the ferryman is at the landing in winter too.
The G4 lower bound covers vikhtuy_locality only; generated places of other G4 can be empty (about 1/3).
